decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation is only mentioned on the website and may be overlapping with the new LC400 cabin, but it still complements the laser portfolio of a marking specialist like REA.
High-resolution thermal inkjet is a core product line for the firm and keeps its own dedicated page.
The piezo HR inkjet extends the core coding business to industrial inks and stays prominently presented.
The industrial laser marking systems are featured on the home page and form a strategic growth line.
The LC400 cabin was just launched and promoted as new, so the firm will give it time in the market.
The award-winning HR-Lube system targets a niche sheet metal application with a distinctive offering worth developing further.
